# SiyaSphere

> SiyaSphere is a GTM and RevOps consultancy (Indore, India; serving clients worldwide) that fixes broken go-to-market systems for B2B SaaS companies. We design and implement RevOps frameworks, marketing automation, Salesforce and HubSpot architecture, lead routing, sales analytics, and AI-powered GTM workflows with human-in-the-loop review.

Engagements typically follow an 8-week process from GTM audit to launch, for B2B SaaS companies from roughly $2M to $100M+ ARR. A free 30-minute GTM audit is available at https://www.siyasphere.in/contact.

## Services

- [GTM Solutions](https://www.siyasphere.in/solutions): RevOps transformation, GTM data migration and system modernization, marketing intelligence and analytics, sales intelligence and analytics, executive dashboards, AI + human GTM workflows, AI-powered GTM tech stack, account intelligence and prospect research
- [The Modern GTM Stack](https://www.siyasphere.in/gtm-stack): How SiyaSphere connects marketing automation, RevOps, and AI workflows into one go-to-market system
- [How It Works](https://www.siyasphere.in/how-it-works): The 8-week GTM transformation process
